# Generated files

The following files are generated or copied by `libbitcoin-build` from `version4.xml`. Each file is hosted in, and customized for, its own repository. `<repository>` is the full repository name (e.g. `libbitcoin-database`), and `<repository suffix>` is the name without the `libbitcoin-` prefix (e.g. `database`).
